value.rationale: Exact finite-sketch instability probability and two sharp asymptotic laws calibrate a qualitative dynamical risk for a newly proposed Hamiltonian assembly procedure; preservation of skew canonical form and energy is distinguished from preservation of positive energy and bounded motion. The family is sparse, positive definite for every coupling and supports arbitrary weak coupling and compressive dimensions. This is an interpretable stability benchmark beyond a routine numerical test.
